name: REBELS-04 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy REBELS-04, seen by Hubble.
label: dustyz82-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field lies a luminous galaxy from the early universe, one in which ALMA had found glowing dust. Hubble looked for a sharp view of its starlight to set beside that dusty glow.

claims.text: The Hubble target DUSTY-Z8-2 is REBELS-04, also called XMM-J-355
ALMA detected dust emission from the program's targets, luminous galaxies in the early universe
Hubble imaging was to give a sharp view of the unobscured star formation to match ALMA's view
